title: Greek Shrimp Skewers
description: A refreshing and flavorful Greek-inspired appetizer or snack, featuring zesty marinated shrimp grilled to perfection.
instructions: Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, zesty seasoning, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shrimp to the marinade, tossing to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Thread the marinated shrimp onto the skewers.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the shrimp are pink and cooked through.
Transfer the skewers to a plate and top with crumbled feta cheese and chopped parsley.
